If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)","argumentHint":"","aliases":["docx"]},{"name":"anthropic-skills:import-memory","description":"Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DhuZvhv3ydd3uV96Ws1mZv","type":"tool_result","content":"2225\t            contract = \"tools/aria-poc/ci_executor_contract_proven.md\"\n2226\t            raise ClaudeCliUnavailable(f\"{exc}; see {contract}\") from exc\n2227\t        raise\n2228\t    # Plan ARIA-V7 §2g v2 + V7.10 envelope-extraction fix.\n2229\t    #\n2230\t    # WHY: claude -p stream-json emits JSONL events\n2231\t    # ({\"result\": \"...\", \"total_cost_usd\": ..., ...}) where the agent's final message may contain the\n2232\t    # actual aria/agent-response/v1 envelope as fenced ```json``` block\n2233\t    # or as final JSON block. Writing raw JSONL to output_path means\n2234\t    # kernel submit-result reads runtime telemetry instead of the envelope,\n2235\t    # which fails:\n2236\t    #   response_schema: missing required fields:\n2237\t    #     ['$schema', 'request_id', 'claim_id', 'agent_id', 'role',\n2238\t    #      'status', 'satisfaction_matrix']\n2239\t    #\n2240\t    # HOW: parse JSONL, extract the final message, find the embedded\n2241\t    # envelope JSON, INJECT mandatory identity fields ($schema,\n2242\t    # request_id, claim_id, agent_id, role, status) from the known\n2243\t    # ci_executor context (these aren't the agent's job — the agent\n2244\t    # only knows its plan content), synthesize a satisfaction_matrix\n2245\t    # from must_satisfy with verdict=satisfied when the agent omitted\n2246\t    # it, then write the corrected envelope to output_path.\n2247\t    #\n2248\t    # Tier hierarchy: Tier-2 (Make it automatic) — the envelope shape\n2249\t    # is now produced correctly by default; Writing raw JSONL to output_path means\n    # kernel submit-result reads runtime telemetry instead of the envelope,\n    # which fails:\n    #   response_schema: missing required fields:\n    #     ['$schema', 'request_id', 'claim_id', 'agent_id', 'role',\n    #      'status', 'satisfaction_matrix']\n    #\n    # HOW: parse JSONL, extract the final message, find the embedded\n    # envelope JSON, INJECT mandatory identity fields ($schema,\n    # request_id, claim_id, agent_id, role, status) from the known\n    # ci_executor context (these aren't the agent's job — the agent\n    # only knows its plan content), synthesize a satisfaction_matrix\n    # from must_satisfy with verdict=satisfied when the agent omitted\n    # it, then write the corrected envelope to output_path.\n    #\n    # Tier hierarchy: Tier-2 (Make it automatic) — the envelope shape\n    # is now produced correctly by default; agents don't have to know\n    # internal kernel identity fields.\n    if completed.stdout:\n        envelope = _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n            raw_stdout=completed.stdout,\n            request_id=request_id,\n            claim_id=claim_id or \"\",\n            agent_id=agent_id or \"\",\n            role=role,\n            subagent_type=subagent_type,\n            must_satisfy=must_satisfy or [],\n            dispatch_model=agent_profile.model,\n        )\n        envelope[\"details\"][\"agent_contract_hash\"] = agent_contract.contract_hash\n        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        _write_sanitized_envelope(output_path, envelope)\n        resolved_transcript_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        resolved_transcript_path.write_text(completed.stdout, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n        # Plan ARIA-V3.1-D3 — per-LLM-call cost attribution. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012378nLFMv9LJEvGVypr2ss","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Bridge between bound-agent submissions and the existing consensus engine.\n2\t\n3\tPlan 016 Faz C5/C6: when an envelope-routed judge submits an ACCEPTED\n4\tresponse, the kernel must record the verdict in `feedback_store`'s\n5\t`operator-feedback.jsonl` ledger as an `ai_judge` row so the existing\n6\t`generate_ai_consensus` engine can compute consensus over multiple judge\n7\tverdicts. Without this bridge, the lease lifecycle ACCEPT terminal state\n8\tis decoupled from the consensus pipeline and a finding can never be\n9\tpromoted from raw -> consensus -> operator-facing.\n10\t\n11\tPer operator instruction: `feedback_store.generate_ai_consensus` and\n12\t`plan_convergence` are NOT replaced. This module is a one-way adapter\n13\tthat translates an `aria/agent-response/v1` envelope into the\n14\t`record_operator_feedback` shape — no judgment logic is duplicated.\n15\t\n16\tGoldset and Change-Intelligence wire-up (C6) routes through the same\n17\thook: when role is `goldset_curation` or `change_intelligence`, the\n18\tbridge extracts `details.proposal` / `details.impact_map` and persists\n19\tthem under `aria-tools/judgment-pipeline/<role>/<request_id>.json` so\n20\toperator commands (`aria-kernel goldset propose`, change-intelligence\n21\trevalidation queues) can consume them without re-reading the response\n22\tenvelope themselves.\n23\t\"\"\"\n24\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n25\t\n26\timport json\n27\tfrom pathlib import Path\n28\tfrom typing import Any\n29\t\n30\tfrom .agent_surface import JUDGE_ROLES, SUPPORTING_ROLES\n31\tfrom .confidence import confidence_in_unit_interval\n32\tfrom .feedback_store import (\n33\t    CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS,\n34\t    CONSENSUS_MIN_CONFIDENCE,\n35\t    FEEDBACK_SEVERITIES,\n36\t    FEEDBACK_VERDICTS,\n37\t    generate_ai_consensus,\n38\t    record_operator_feedback,\n39\t)\n40\tfrom .tool_registry import GovernanceError, append_tools_governance, ensure_tools_dir, utc_now\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tdef is_judge_role(role: str | None) -> bool:\n44\t    return role in JUDGE_ROLES\n45\t\n46\t\n47\tdef is_supporting_role(role: str | None) -> bool:\n48\t    return role in SUPPORTING_ROLES\n49\t\n50\t\n51\tdef _coerce_severity(value: Any, *, fallback: str = \"medium\") -> str:\n52\t    \"\"\"feedback_store accepts {low, medium, high, critical}; agent envelope\n53\t    may use uppercase per finding schema. Normalize without rejecting.\"\"\"\n54\t    if not isinstance(value, str):\n55\t        return fallback\n56\t    normalized = value.strip().lower()\n57\t    if normalized in FEEDBACK_SEVERITIES:\n58\t        return normalized\n59\t    if normalized == \"informational\":\n60\t        return \"low\"\n61\t    return fallback\n62\t\n63\t\n64\tdef _verdict_field(details: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n65\t    \"\"\"The judge .md prompts shape verdicts under details.verdict (evidence,\n66\t    adversarial) or details.consensus (arbiter). Return whichever exists.\n67\t    \"\"\"\n68\t    if isinstance(details.get(\"verdict\"), dict):\n69\t        return dict(details[\"verdict\"])\n70\t    if isinstance(details.get(\"consensus\"), dict):\n71\t        return dict(details[\"consensus\"])\n72\t    if isinstance(details.get(\"verdict\"), str):\n73\t        # Flat shape (ORPHAN-HIGH-629 sibling): the judge contract file says\n74\t        # BOTH \"Return JSON with: verdict, judge_id, confidence...\" and\n75\t        # \"details.verdict.rationale\". The first live judge run answered\n76\t        # flat, was ACCEPTED by the envelope gate, and dropped HERE with\n77\t        # \"expected verdict ..., got None\" — a verdict lost between two\n78\t        # halves of one document. Honour both spellings; the envelope gate\n79\t        # stays the only authority on validity.\n80\t        return {\n81\t            key: details.get(key)\n82\t            for key in (\n83\t                \"verdict\", \"tool_id\", \"run_id\", \"finding_id\", \"judge_id\",\n84\t                \"model\", \"prompt_hash\", \"confidence\", \"rationale\",\n85\t                \"evidence_refs\", \"judgment_group_id\", \"severity\",\n86\t            )\n87\t            if details.get(key) is not None\n88\t        }\n89\t    return {}\n90\t\n91\t\n92\tdef validate_judge_response(\n93\t    *,\n94\t    request: dict[str, Any],\n95\t    response: dict[str, Any],\n96\t) -> list[str]:\n97\t    \"\"\"Y5 (ORPHAN-706) — the judge output contract, checkable BEFORE accept.\n98\t\n99\t    The second sealed night accepted 12 judge results whose envelopes never\n100\t    carried a verdict the bridge could read (\"expected verdict ..., got\n101\t    None\") — each one an accepted row that could never fold, burning bridge\n102\t    retries toward permanent_fail. This is the SINGLE definition of what a\n103\t    judge response must carry; ``record_judge_verdict_from_response`` raises\n104\t    on exactly this list, and the executor's pre-submit gate releases the\n105\t    claim on it instead of sealing an unfoldable result.\n106\t\n107\t    Returns [] for non-judge roles: the contract binds judges only.\n108\t    \"\"\"\n109\t    role = response.get(\"role\")\n110\t    if not is_judge_role(role):\n111\t        return []\n112\t    errors: list[str] = []\n113\t    details = response.get(\"details\") or {}\n114\t    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n115\t        details = {}\n116\t    verdict_block = _verdict_field(details)\n117\t    if not verdict_block:\n118\t        return [\"judge_verdict:absent\"]\n119\t    verdict = verdict_block.get(\"verdict\")\n120\t    if verdict not in FEEDBACK_VERDICTS:\n121\t        # ORPHAN-CRITICAL-735 — the arbiter's contract says \"return\n122\t        # details.consensus, OR the uncertainty reason when the consensus\n123\t        # gate cannot be met\", and the deterministic engine it mirrors\n124\t        # emits exactly that non-verdict outcome. The live arbiter obeyed\n125\t        # and this contract burned the claim as invalid:None — fourth\n126\t        # mint-vs-law instance. Uncertainty is a VALID arbitration\n127\t        # outcome, for the arbiter alone, with a reason from the closed\n128\t        # vocabulary; binary judges stay bound to binary verdicts.\n129\t        reason = verdict_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n130\t        if (\n131\t            role == \"consensus_arbitration\"\n132\t            and verdict is None\n133\t            and reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS\n134\t        ):\n135\t            pass\n136\t        else:\n137\t            errors.append(f\"judge_verdict.verdict:invalid:{verdict!r}\")\n138\t    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n139\t    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n140\t    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n141\t    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n142\t        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_tool_run_or_finding_id\")\n143\t    judge_id = details.get(\"agent_subagent_type\") or verdict_block.get(\"judge_id\")\n144\t    if not judge_id:\n145\t        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_judge_identity\")\n146\t    elif str(judge_id).startswith(\"ci-executor:\"):\n147\t        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:executor_shaped_judge_identity\")\n148\t    return between bound-agent submissions and the existing consensus engine.\n\nPlan 016 Faz C5/C6: when an envelope-routed judge submits an ACCEPTED\nresponse, the kernel must record the verdict in `feedback_store`'s\n`operator-feedback.jsonl` ledger as an `ai_judge` row so the existing\n`generate_ai_consensus` engine can compute consensus over multiple judge\nverdicts. Without this bridge, the lease lifecycle ACCEPT terminal state\nis decoupled from the consensus pipeline and a finding can never be\npromoted from raw -> consensus -> operator-facing.\n\nPer operator instruction: `feedback_store.generate_ai_consensus` and\n`plan_convergence` are NOT replaced. This module is a one-way adapter\nthat translates an `aria/agent-response/v1` envelope into the\n`record_operator_feedback` shape — no judgment logic is duplicated.\n\nGoldset and Change-Intelligence wire-up (C6) routes through the same\nhook: when role is `goldset_curation` or `change_intelligence`, the\nbridge extracts `details.proposal` / `details.impact_map` and persists\nthem under `aria-tools/judgment-pipeline/<role>/<request_id>.json` so\noperator commands (`aria-kernel goldset propose`, change-intelligence\nrevalidation queues) can consume them without re-reading the response\nenvelope themselves.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom .agent_surface import JUDGE_ROLES, SUPPORTING_ROLES\nfrom .confidence import confidence_in_unit_interval\nfrom .feedback_store import (\n    CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS,\n    CONSENSUS_MIN_CONFIDENCE,\n    FEEDBACK_SEVERITIES,\n    FEEDBACK_VERDICTS,\n    generate_ai_consensus,\n    record_operator_feedback,\n)\nfrom .tool_registry import GovernanceError, append_tools_governance, ensure_tools_dir, utc_now\n\n\ndef is_judge_role(role: str | None) -> bool:\n    return role in JUDGE_ROLES\n\n\ndef is_supporting_role(role: str | None) -> bool:\n    return role in SUPPORTING_ROLES\n\n\ndef _coerce_severity(value: Any, *, fallback: str = \"medium\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"feedback_store accepts {low, medium, high, critical}; agent envelope\n    may use uppercase per finding schema. Normalize without rejecting.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        return fallback\n    normalized = value.strip().lower()\n    if normalized in FEEDBACK_SEVERITIES:\n        return normalized\n    if normalized == \"informational\":\n        return \"low\"\n    return fallback\n\n\ndef _verdict_field(details: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"The judge .md prompts shape verdicts under details.verdict (evidence,\n    adversarial) or details.consensus (arbiter). Return whichever exists.\n    \"\"\"\n    if isinstance(details.get(\"verdict\"), dict):\n        return dict(details[\"verdict\"])\n    if isinstance(details.get(\"consensus\"), dict):\n        return dict(details[\"consensus\"])\n    if isinstance(details.get(\"verdict\"), str):\n        # Flat shape (ORPHAN-HIGH-629 sibling): the judge contract file says\n        # BOTH \"Return JSON with: verdict, judge_id, confidence...\" and\n        # \"details.verdict.rationale\". The first live judge run answered\n        # flat, was ACCEPTED by the envelope gate, and dropped HERE with\n        # \"expected verdict ..., got None\" — a verdict lost between two\n        # halves of one document. Honour both spellings; the envelope gate\n        # stays the only authority on validity.\n        return {\n            key: details.get(key)\n            for key in (\n                \"verdict\", \"tool_id\", \"run_id\", \"finding_id\", \"judge_id\",\n                \"model\", \"prompt_hash\", \"confidence\", \"rationale\",\n                \"evidence_refs\", \"judgment_group_id\", \"severity\",\n            )\n            if details.get(key) is not None\n        }\n    return {}\n\n\ndef validate_judge_response(\n    *,\n    request: dict[str, Any],\n    response: dict[str, Any],\n) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Y5 (ORPHAN-706) — the judge output contract, checkable BEFORE accept.\n\n    The second sealed night accepted 12 judge results whose envelopes never\n    carried a verdict the bridge could read (\"expected verdict ..., got\n    None\") — each one an accepted row that could never fold, burning bridge\n    retries toward permanent_fail. This is the SINGLE definition of what a\n    judge response must carry; ``record_judge_verdict_from_response`` raises\n    on exactly this list, and the executor's pre-submit gate releases the\n    claim on it instead of sealing an unfoldable result.\n\n    Returns [] for non-judge roles: the contract binds judges only.\n    \"\"\"\n    role = response.get(\"role\")\n    if not is_judge_role(role):\n        return []\n    errors: list[str] = []\n    details = response.get(\"details\") or {}\n    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n        details = {}\n    verdict_block = _verdict_field(details)\n    if not verdict_block:\n        return [\"judge_verdict:absent\"]\n    verdict = verdict_block.get(\"verdict\")\n    if verdict not in FEEDBACK_VERDICTS:\n        # ORPHAN-CRITICAL-735 — the arbiter's contract says \"return\n        # details.consensus, OR the uncertainty reason when the consensus\n        # gate cannot be met\", and the deterministic engine it mirrors\n        # emits exactly that non-verdict outcome. The live arbiter obeyed\n        # and this contract burned the claim as invalid:None — fourth\n        # mint-vs-law instance. Uncertainty is a VALID arbitration\n        # outcome, for the arbiter alone, with a reason from the closed\n        # vocabulary; binary judges stay bound to binary verdicts.\n        reason = verdict_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n        if (\n            role == \"consensus_arbitration\"\n            and verdict is None\n            and reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS\n        ):\n            pass\n        else:\n            errors.append(f\"judge_verdict.verdict:invalid:{verdict!r}\")\n    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_tool_run_or_finding_id\")\n    judge_id = details.get(\"agent_subagent_type\") or verdict_block.get(\"judge_id\")\n    if not judge_id:\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_judge_identity\")\n    elif str(judge_id).startswith(\"ci-executor:\"):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:executor_shaped_judge_identity\")\n    return errors\n\n","numLines":150,"startLine":1,"totalLines":388}}}
